name: Keys of Ingenuity
description: A replica modeled after Sandrone's recovered mechanical piano. The entire piece boasts a warm, golden luster, complemented by the sleek and elegant lines of its classical frame. Looking closely at the decorative carvings, one can almost feel the passage of time flowing silently through the intricate details.\n"Fine! One piece and that's it!" As the beautiful music played, everyone took the opportunity to savor this rare and hard-won moment of reunion...
